upstream.section: Direction in subgraphs

flowchart LR
    subgraph subgraph1
        direction TB
        top1[top] --> bottom1[bottom]
    end
    subgraph subgraph2
        direction TB
        top2[top] --> bottom2[bottom]
    end
    %% ^ These subgraphs are identical, except for the links to them:

    %% Link *to* subgraph1: subgraph1 direction is maintained
    outside --> subgraph1
    %% Link *within* subgraph2:
    %% subgraph2 inherits the direction of the top-level graph (LR)
    outside ---> top2

upstream.section: Subgraphs; Direction in subgraphs (empty group regression)

cases.source:
flowchart TB
Entry["Receive a batch"] --> Pipeline
subgraph Pipeline["Processing pipeline with isolated direction scopes"]
  direction LR
  subgraph Validation["Validation from top to bottom"]
    direction TB
    Read["Read next item"] --> Valid{"Schema valid?"}
    Valid -->|yes| Accepted["Keep item"]
    Valid -->|no| Repair["Repair input"]
    Repair -. retry .-> Read
  end
  subgraph Storage["Storage from bottom to top"]
    direction BT
    Append["Append journal"] --> Durable{"Commit durable?"}
    Durable -->|yes| Publish["Publish revision"]
    Durable -->|no| Retry["Retry transaction"]
    Retry -. retry .-> Append
  end
  Validation -->|accepted batch| Storage
end
subgraph Audit["Audit from right to left"]
  direction RL
  Record["Record revision"] --> Verified{"Checksum valid?"}
  Verified -->|yes| Seal["Seal history"]
  Verified -->|no| Recheck["Recheck journal"]
  Recheck -. retry .-> Record
end
Pipeline -->|committed| Audit
Audit --> Exit["Revision available"]
